request.description: Update a schedule block. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. All body fields optional. When updating time (hour, minute, dayPart must all be provided together). Validates no overlaps after update. Schedule must be in DRAFT status.

response.name: Success
Error - Not Found

request.description: Delete a schedule block by ID. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. Schedule must be in DRAFT status.

response.name: Success
Success

request.description: Materialize broadcast slots from weekly schedule block templates for a date range. Schedule must be ACTIVE. If fromDate/toDate are omitted, uses the schedule's effectiveFrom/effectiveTo. Idempotent: existing slots are skipped. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission.

response.name: Success

request.description: List broadcast slots for a schedule with optional filters: status (SCHEDULED|AIRED|MISSED|PREEMPTED|CANCELLED), dayOfWeek, showId, broadcastType, dateFrom, dateTo. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission.
